document.inspect.label: Inspect Document
document.inspect.params: {} → pages, spreads, items, stories (with overset), styles, swatches, selection

file.new.label: Document…
file.new.params: {preset?: "Letter"|"A4"|…, width?, height?, pages?, facingPages?, columns?, gutter?, margins?: number|{top,bottom,inside,outside}, bleed?, title?}

file.package.label: Package…
file.package.params: {dir: folder to create, idml?: true, pdf?: false, instructions?: text} — the document (its placed files relinked to Links/), Links/, the font files that draw its text in Document Fonts/ (fallback fonts included; unless their licence restricts it), an IDML copy, an optional PDF and a report → {dir, files, report}

file.place.label: Place…
file.place.params: {path?|base64?, name?, frame?: id (place into), spread?, x?, y?, width?, pdfPage?: n (1-based, Image Import Options), pdfCrop?: crop|trim|bleed|art|media, layoutPage?: n (IDML / .designcraft: that page's objects as a group)} — places an image (into the selected empty frame if any); text files (.txt, .docx, .rtf, .md) and Excel workbooks (.xlsx, as a table) go into the insertion point, the selected frame or a new frame on `page`/`rect` — {autoflow?: adds pages with threaded frames until the text fits, removeStyles?, styleMap?: {imported name: document style}, styleConflicts?: useExisting|redefine|autoRename}

frame.create.label: Create Frame
frame.create.params: {spread?: index | {kind: doc|parent, index} (a parent spread: index into `parents` of document.inspect), rect: [x0,y0,x1,y1] (spread coords), shape?: rectangle|ellipse|polygon, content?: graphic|text|unassigned, sides?: 6, text?: string, caret?: bool, vertical?: bool (text: a new vertical story)}

hyperlink.create.label: New Hyperlink…
hyperlink.create.params: {url? | email? | page? (1-based), name?, ids?} — from the selected text, or the selected frames

links.list.label: Links
links.list.params: {} → [{asset, name, path, status: ok|modified|missing|embedded, pixels, uses: [{id, page, ppi}]}]

object.qrCode.label: Generate QR Code…
object.qrCode.params: {type?: url|text|sms|email|vcard (default url), content (url/text), number?, message?, to?, subject?, body?, name?, phone?, email?, org?, url?, color? (swatch, [Black]), rect? (new object; else into the selected frame, or re-encode a selected code), spread?} → {id, content}

story.get.label: Get Story
story.get.params: {story? | frame?} → text, frames, paragraphs, vertical, overset

style.paragraph.create.label: New Paragraph Style…
style.paragraph.create.params: {name, basedOn?, nextStyle?, para?: {…}, chars?: {…}, fromSelection?: bool}

text.select.label: Select Text
text.select.params: {story, anchor, focus} (UTF-8 byte offsets into the story text, as find.find reports them: á or — counts 2 or 3)
